name: Digital Identity
title: Professional Business Storefronts
summary: Every business now gets a polished, trustworthy storefront — with a cover banner, key stats at a glance, trust badges, and a gallery you control from your dashboard.

features: Businesses can add a cover banner to the top of their storefront.
New at-a-glance business stats: how long they've been serving, whether they're open now, typical response time, photo count, and customers served.
Trust badges — Featured Partner, Verified, Top Rated and Trusted Seller — now appear on qualifying storefronts.
Merchants can organise their photo gallery into categories like Interior, Products, Services and Team.
Structured Business Highlights let merchants showcase what makes them special.
improvements: The 'More' menu and QR-code sharing on storefronts are now smoother and work reliably on mobile.
Open / Closed status is now accurate for businesses that stay open past midnight.
Cleaner storefront layout when a business hasn't added photos or a cover yet.
bugFixes: Fixed the QR-code button that previously did nothing.
Fixed gallery navigation arrows that could be cut off on small screens.

impact.customers: Storefronts now look and feel trustworthy at a glance — a cover photo, at-a-glance stats, and trust badges help customers decide faster without extra digging.
impact.businesses: Vendors get a real digital identity to manage themselves: cover banner, organised photo gallery, and structured highlights, all from their own dashboard.
impact.platform: Cloudinary media handling is now type-aware (cover vs gallery vs verification), and BusinessProfile.metaData carries structured highlights and gallery categories without any schema migration.

technicalChangelog: storefront.js: added renderCover, renderHeroStats, computeOpenStatus (overnight-aware), TRUST_TIERS data-driven registry + getTrustBadges, setupOverflowMenu, local showNotification toast; rebound QR to sf-btn-show-qr-overflow.
app.js (dashboard): replaced mock media upload/delete with real /media endpoints; added cover management (upload/replace/preview/remove), structured highlights persistence, gallery categorization.
media.service.js: added 'cover' media type with 3:1 c_fill/g_auto smart-crop and single-cover enforcement.
business.service.js: getBusinessBySlug now includes _count.reviews for the Customer Count stat.
storefront.html: fixed lightbox align-items typo and repositioned prev/next arrows inside the viewport.
featureList: Cover banner media type ('cover') end to end (dashboard + storefront).
bugFixList: Dead QR button rebound to overflow-menu control.
Lightbox arrows clipped at -40px on mobile.
storefront.js referenced undefined showNotification (page does not load app.js).
improvementList: Overflow 'More' menu with outside-click + Escape dismissal.
Empty-state handling for missing cover / gallery / hours / trust tier.
internal.migrationNotes: None. No schema migration. Cover uses BusinessMedia.type='cover'; gallery categories and highlights live in BusinessProfile.metaData (JSON). Production Neon DB untouched.
internal.rollbackNotes: Revert the frontend (storefront.js, app.js, storefront.html) and the two service files (media.service.js, business.service.js). No data migration to reverse; existing 'cover' media and metaData keys are inert if the readers are reverted.
